function.name: get_api_info
function.description: Describe the Eurex reference-data API and this tool set: endpoint, datasets, whether the shared demo key is in use. Call first if unsure what is available.

function.name: search_products
function.description: Find Eurex products by code, name, ISIN or underlying (case-insensitive, all words must match). Returns code, name, ISIN, type and currency.

function.name: get_product
function.description: Product card in one call: master data, trading hours with live status, tick rules, TES profiles, next holidays and upcoming expirations.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

function.name: get_market_status
function.description: Is a product trading now (or at a given time)? Computes open / tes / closed / holiday from TradingHours and Holidays. Times are Europe/Berlin.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

at.description: ISO date-time to check, e.g. 2026-12-24T10:00:00. Without a zone it is read as Eurex time (Europe/Berlin). Default: now.

function.name: get_tick_size
function.description: Tick (price step) rules of a product: the step that applies at a price, whether the price is on the grid, and the nearest valid prices.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

price.description: Price to check. Omit to get the whole band table.

instrument_type.description: e.g. a simple instrument (default) or a strategy type.

function.name: get_expirations
function.description: Expiration calendar of a product (upcoming by default), with the expiration index and master contract.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

upcoming_only.description: Only expirations from today on (default true).

function.name: get_holidays
function.description: Exchange holidays of a product (upcoming by default).

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

function.name: list_contracts
function.description: Listed series of a product (futures or options), optionally narrowed by contract date (e.g. 2026-12 or 202612) and call/put.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

function.name: get_strikes
function.description: Option strikes per contract date of an options product: sorted unique strikes, split into calls and puts.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

contract_date.description: Contract month, e.g. 2026-12 (prefix match). Omit for all.

function.name: get_tes_thresholds
function.description: T7 Entry Service (TES, off-book) minimum lot sizes and non-disclosure limits per expiration, from TESProfiles and Expirations.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

tes_type.description: TESType to use. Default: the first group listed.

instrument_type.description: InstrumentType to use. Default: the first group listed.

function.name: get_settlement_prices
function.description: Settlement price history of a product, newest first. Narrow with contract_id, price_type or since to keep the answer small.

product.description: Eurex product code, e.g. FESX (Euro STOXX 50 futures) or OESX (its options). Use search_products if you only have a name, ISIN or underlying.

since.description: Only SettlementDate on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

function.name: get_changes
function.description: Announced and past changes to the API data (Changelog), newest first; optionally only entries that mention a product code or text.

mentions.description: Keep entries whose text mentions this (e.g. a product code or dataset name).

since.description: Only entries dated on or after this (YYYY-MM-DD).

function.name: get_schema
function.description: Introspect the GraphQL schema. Without type_name: all datasets (root queries) with arguments. With type_name: the fields, input fields or enum values of that type. Use it instead of guessing names.

type_name.description: e.g. Contract, or a filter input type name taken from the root query arguments.

function.name: run_graphql
function.description: Escape hatch: run a read-only GraphQL query against the Eurex API and get the raw result. Contracts, FlexibleContracts and SettlementPrices must be filtered by Product. Prefer the specific tools.

max_chars.description: Truncate the JSON result to this many characters (default 20000).
